browser.scope: 3 fresh desktop and 3 mobile Chromium contexts; mobile 1.6 Mbps down / 750 Kbps up, 150ms latency and 4x CPU; one client location, synthetic lab only

limitations: Native elapsed time includes local workerd and host contention; it is not provider CPU.
Public load lasts about 25 seconds for paced cohorts; it is not a 24-hour capacity test.
Production day is partial through collection time, not the future requested end.
Canonical adversarial fixture observations are not representative production latency tails.
Successful live hosted Turn cohort unavailable during allocation exhaustion.
No guaranteed peak heap or unbiased cold-start population is available.
